name: rapid-backspace
description: Grapheme-count lock (SPEC section 8): old 'hello👋🏽!' has graphemes h,e,l,l,o,👋🏽,! = 7 (the waving-hand + skin-tone modifier is ONE extended grapheme cluster); new 'hel' shares prefix 3, so bs = 7 - 3 = 4. UTF-16 or byte counting would give a different number — this fixture fails any codec counting in the wrong unit.
